Name: Tall Hus... Wives
Author: RedK1rby
Description:
This mod makes your genderbent husbands taller and also makes changes to improve clarity and designs of the sprites, due to the taller sizes. It uses Adarin's designs and the edits I've made before of the bachelors. For now, Alex and Elena(Elliott) are done, with the rest of the bachelors in the making!

[b]This only has the character sprites, for portraits you will need other mods!
For example, my portrait mods:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21500]Female Bachelors - Winter[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7342]Female Bachelors - Beach[/url][/b]

[size=4]Requirements:[/size]
Make sure you have the following mods installed.
[list]
[*][size=2][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42083]Idle Plus Walk[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[/list]After that, you just need to extract the file inside the "mods" folder.

[size=4]What has been done:[/size]
[size=3]Alex[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Normal Sprites[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Winter Sprites[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Beach Sprites[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Optional Ear Muffs for Winter Sprites[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3]Alex has the "EnableAlexNoEarMuff" option in the config file:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]"true" - Removes the earmuffs.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]"false" - Keeps the earmuffs.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=2][size=3]Elena(Elliott)[/size][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][size=2]Normal Sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][size=2]Winter Sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][size=2]Beach Sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][size=2]Optional Red Ribbon for Winter Sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[size=3]Elena has the "EnableElenaRedRibbon" option in the config file:[/size][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][size=2]"true" - Changes the color of her hair ribbon to red (Only Winter).[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][size=2]"false" - Keeps the original green color of her hair ribbon.[/size][/size][/*]
[/list]
Sabrina(Sebastian)
[list]
[*]Normal Sprites[/*]
[*]Winter Sprites[/*]
[*]Beach Sprites[/*]
[*]Optional Covered Hands for Normal Sprites[/*]
[/list]
Sabrina has the "EnableSabrinaCoveredHands" option in the config file:
[list]
[*]"true" - Makes her put her hands into her hoodie while Idle  in Normal Sprites.[/*]
[*]"false" - Makes her put her hands onto her hips while Idle in Normal Sprites.[/*]
[/list][size=4]Sorry for the delay! [/size]
The 0.3 update took some time, sorry, I've just been really busy these days. I will continue making this mod, but it's going to take longer than expected...


[size=4]Also, please, share your thoughts![/size]
